subject.title: feat(commands): add /learn to draft skills from recent work

question: Should `/learn` be accepted as a built-in core command that reserves the `learn` command name across text, native, and plugin command surfaces?
rationale: The implementation shape is plausible and uses the existing Skill Workshop approval path, but it adds a new core command and compatibility-sensitive command namespace reservation.

options.title: Approve after repair
options.body: Land the built-in command after the review findings, generated docs metadata, and real behavior proof are addressed.

options.title: Keep the issue open for direction
options.body: Do not merge this PR until maintainers decide whether the core command namespace is worth the compatibility cost.

options.title: Route outside core
options.body: Ask for a plugin or ClawHub affordance instead if maintainers do not want another built-in command.

recommendation.title: Approve after repair
recommendation.body: Land the built-in command after the review findings, generated docs metadata, and real behavior proof are addressed.
